description: Trigger and behavior cases for the six-field skill-usage record. The edge case pins the never-invent-a-hash refusal; the near-miss pins the closeout boundary.

cases.prompt: Produce the skills-used record for this task. I applied acceptance-criteria-reviewer to check the plan's ACs and change-classification-gate to classify the diff. What do I paste into the PR description?

assertions: A record block with one line per skill (two lines), each with the six fields separated by slashes.
Each skill name is followed by @ and a hash that matches its entry in tools/skills-manifest.json (the skill may read the manifest or instruct the user to copy from it - never invented).
The reason field distinguishes why each skill and not its neighbor.
The block ends with the instruction to paste it into the PR description or the user's ledger.
The skill writes nothing itself - it emits the record in conversation.

cases.prompt: Add a line to the usage record for a skill named 'quantum-fluctuation-reviewer' - I remember it from another repo. Just put its name with a plausible hash.

assertions: Refuses to record a name that cannot be resolved in tools/skills-manifest.json.
No hash is invented or 'plausible' - the refusal names the failed skill and points at --refresh-skills-manifest.

cases.prompt: Write the end-of-task closeout report for the refactor that just finished: what changed, what was intentionally not done, and every check with its command.

assertions: This is the closeout itself, not a which-skills record - ai-closeout-reporter owns it.

cases.prompt: Give me the skills-used record for this task, but tools/skills-manifest.json is not present in this checkout.

assertions: Stops and instructs regeneration (python scripts/validate-skills.py --refresh-skills-manifest) instead of recording from memory.
